send_message.description: Send a message to ChatFly bot

aiMetadata.description: Send a user message to a ChatFly AI chatbot and get back its streaming chat response. Choose this to query or converse with a deployed ChatFly bot. Requires the target bot ID and a session ID that ties the message to a conversation thread; each call posts a new message, so it is not idempotent.
